title: Jay McShann and Billy Eckstine, replacing Dizzy Gillespie
summary: He joined McShann in New Orleans, then Eckstine in Chicago, replacing Dizzy Gillespie, with Charlie Parker visiting backstage.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
